title: The equal-time Wick quartic L2 threshold is dimension dependent and one spatial dimension is the positive control

threshold.spectral_decay: The equal-time covariance has q_k asymptotic to |k|^-1
threshold.positive_control: In d=1, q belongs to ell^(4/3); Hausdorff-Young gives C_N to C in L4, hence Var(V_N)=24||C_N||_4^4 converges and the Wick martingale converges in L2
threshold.integer_threshold: For every integer d>=2 the K1433 cone lower bound grows as N^(3d-4) and diverges
threshold.continuum_check: The local equal-time kernel scales as |x|^(-(d-1)); its fourth power is locally integrable exactly when 4(d-1)<d, equivalently d<4/3
threshold.covariance_fence: This threshold is for q_k=(2 sqrt(m^2+|k|^2))^-1. A Euclidean covariance (m^2+|k|^2)^-1 has different power counting
threshold.claim_ceiling: The one-dimensional control proves that the obstruction is dimensional rather than a failure of Hermite martingale algebra. It supplies no three-dimensional interacting Hamiltonian, source measure or full-PDE estimate
